name: The Shops at La Jolla Village
summary: The Shops at La Jolla Village is the #1 ranked neighborhood retail center in La Jolla, anchored by Whole Foods, Nordstrom Rack, and CVS. This open-air shopping destination offers premium shopping, dining, and services in one of California's most desirable coastal communities, with a unique connection to The Terraces residential community above.
demographics: The Shops at La Jolla Village serves an affluent, educated demographic reflective of the La Jolla community, with visitors typically in the 35-65 age range and household incomes exceeding $100,000. The trade area attracts both local residents from luxury oceanfront homes and professionals working in nearby University City and Torrance, along with tourists visiting the coastal enclave. Shopping patterns emphasize quality over quantity, with strong preference for organic and premium products as evidenced by the Whole Foods anchor, upscale dining options, and specialty retailers. The center also serves residents of The Terraces at La Jolla Village, the residential community located directly above the shopping center, creating a built-in customer base seeking convenience and lifestyle amenities.
description: The Shops at La Jolla Village is a premier open-air shopping destination nestled in the heart of La Jolla, California, one of the most desirable coastal communities in the United States. Managed by EDENS, a community-focused real estate developer, this neighborhood retail center has earned recognition as the #1 ranked neighborhood retail place in the vicinity and stands proudly in the top 10% for shopping center visits within a 30-mile radius. The center is anchored by premium retailers including Whole Foods Market, Nordstrom Rack, and CVS, offering residents and visitors a carefully curated mix of shopping, dining, and services. Recent additions like Bacio di Latte, an authentic Italian gelato shop founded by brothers Edoardo and Luigi, bring international flair and artisanal quality to the tenant mix, complementing existing favorites like Philz Coffee, Nekter Juice Bar, and Handels Ice Cream. The center's unique positioning directly below The Terraces at La Jolla Village residential community creates a vibrant live-work-play environment where connections are made and community thrives. With its focus on quality tenants, beauty and fitness services, casual dining options, and regular community events, The Shops at La Jolla Village offers a welcoming haven where neighbors can discover, inspire, and reconnect with nature and each other amidst the stunning backdrop of La Jolla's coastal beauty.
